Choose A, C or Z weighting, connect an external microphone and organize multiple calibration profiles for different setups.

apps.name: Lumi Letters Pro: ABC Phonics
apps.summary: Real phonics for little learners: hear the sound, find it in the word, trace the letter. In the Parent Zone you can follow progress across four core skills and print a daily worksheet. No ads, no subscription, no data collection, and it works offline, a good fit for preschool, JK and kindergarten.

apps.name: Lumi Math Planet: Explorer

All 46 question types are shown in pictures and can be read aloud. Parents can follow progress, practice weak spots and print worksheets with answer keys. No ads, no subscription.

apps.name: Lumi Math Pro: Kids Numbers
apps.summary: Turn real mathematical thinking into a gentle space adventure. Lumi Math Pro helps children ages 3–6 practise counting, number sense, addition, patterns, shapes, and logic in short, playful challenges.

apps.name: QR Code Halo: Scan & Create

Scan with the camera or choose a photo, and links open in your browser, passkey sign-in codes and app links go directly to iOS, Wi-Fi codes bring up the iOS Join prompt, and calls, messages, email and places open in their own apps. Contacts and events open the iOS add screen for you to confirm. Text is copied with a short note, and javascript:, data: or file: codes are never opened. To look at each code first, turn off “Run action after scanning” in Settings; batch scan only collects.
